text_blocks.snippet: Al Roker was diagnosed with prostate cancer in 2020. He shared that he had an aggressive form of the disease, but it was detected early. The diagnosis came after he had elevated PSA levels, which led to further testing including an MRI and biopsy. He underwent surgery to remove his prostate and some surrounding lymph nodes. Roker has been open about his experience, encouraging men, particularly African American men, to get screened for prostate cancer, as they are at higher risk according to Memorial Sloan Kettering Cancer Center.
